title: Best Vanilla+ Modpack
description: the ultimate Minecraft experience with some quality of Life mods
body:
This Modpack adds a Bunch of Mods which are making Minecraft more enjoyable. Some of them are Quality of Life Mods like Zoom, Double Doors, Fullbright, ect. But there are also Mods to Optimize Minecraft to get a better framerate.
This is the ultimate Minecraft Experience Modpack with some cool features, too!


Extra Settings: No fog, GUI-scale to 3, graphics Mode, clouds, weather, leaves to fast.

I also added core Shaders like Energy Shaders or re-Shaded.
I hope you like my Modpack

My other projects: [https://modrinth.com/modpack/max-fps-modpack],[https://modrinth.com/modpack/java-and-stuff-undo21]
